prompt: Single game hero sprite: a fire warrior monk with dark brown skin, top-heavy with broad shoulders and strong arms, a small shaven bald head with a dark crimson seal tattoo on the face and scalp, a calm meditating face with closed eyes; a scorched saffron-orange monk robe draped over one shoulder with charred blackened hems and a dark red sash; an oversized necklace of big black wooden prayer beads; an iron monk staff (a long dark iron rod with three metal rings at its top) held upright in the crook of his left arm, resting against his shoulder; the seal tattoo glows red-orange; small flat layered flame shapes (yellow over orange) at the foot he stands on. Three-quarter view facing down-right. Idle pose: he stands on ONE leg like an old tree, the other leg raised with the knee bent level with the standing knee, the raised foot relaxed; straight but relaxed body, shoulders down; both hands pressed lightly together in front of the chest (alternative: slowly turning the prayer beads); face calm as in meditation (both hands joined in front of the chest). Keep it simple: the face is a few lines with closed eyes, the robe has a few big folds only. Full body including the raised foot and the whole staff, centered, filling about 70% of the frame. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 64 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 64 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. Effects (fire, ice, magic, poison, glow, energy) are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the effect's form (flame tongues, ice shards, drips, sparks), never as soft blur or gradient glow. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
